product.title: Seoul Night Tour with Han River Cruise and Gyeongbokgung Palace

description.text: In Seoul, this private nine-hour evening starts at Gyeongbokgung Palace after a hotel-lobby pickup, then continues onto a Han River night cruise. A driver-guide, private vehicle, fuel, and parking are listed; food and palace or cruise entrance fees follow the booked option. The format suits visitors who want a guided palace-and-river night without assembling a cruise ticket independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Seoul, and the itinerary stays on Gyeongbokgung Palace and the Han River that define this outing rather than a Gwangjang Market walk.

highlights: Hotel pickup in a private vehicle

end.description: Return to your Seoul meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
